_readme: Real customer reviews from the Google profile, copied word for word (typos and capitals as written). They scroll in the carousel on the home page. 'author' is the full Google name; the site shows first name + initial (nameStyle 'short') or the full name (nameStyle 'full'). 'truncated': the text was cut by Google ('More'), so the card adds a link to read it on Google. 'summary': overall score and number of reviews as shown on Google; update it from time to time. After editing run: python scripts/build.py
